nodes.description: A small molecule intended to interfere with amyloid–glycosaminoglycan interactions. In the initial 183-patient randomized trial, the 24-month worsening proportions were 27% versus 40% (P=.06), while the prespecified time-to-event analysis favored eprodisate (HR 0.58, P=.02). Neither end-stage kidney disease nor mortality improved significantly, and there was no proteinuria or amyloid-load benefit. The 261-patient confirmatory trial failed its different renal composite endpoint (HR 1.0, 95% CI 0.7–1.4; P=.882 in 260 treated participants). These findings do not establish a clinically effective AA therapy.

Splenic AA deposition was evaluated after 16 days using blinded Congo-red microscopy and immunohistochemistry. In the FVB Sup35 experiment, 10/12 seeded mice had deposits versus 2/11 controls with minimal deposits; results varied across preparations and strains. This tests experimental cross-seeding, not live bacterial infection, oral transmission or environmental risk in humans.
